reasoning: The long_tx task opens transactions at REPEATABLE READ and acquires FOR UPDATE locks on hot TPC-C keys: all districts of a chosen warehouse and the first 200 stock items in that warehouse. Four concurrent sessions shard by warehouse using CONNECTION_ID() to cover w_id 1–4, increasing the likelihood that background New-Order and Payment transactions block on district and stock rows. Holding these locks for ~12 seconds is designed to elevate Innodb_row_lock_waits/time (lock_contention), inflate p95 latency (slow_query), and potentially reduce QPS (qps_drop), matching the specified propagation path.
